groups.name: Recurrent encoder-decoders with attention
groups.dimension: how the decoder accesses the source sentence and how much computation is sequential
groups.comparison: fixed-length encoding vs. soft-search over source positions; both keep step-by-step recurrent computation

groups.name: Convolutional sequence models
groups.dimension: parallelism during training vs. path length between distant positions
groups.comparison: ConvS2S parallelises over all elements; residual connections (He et al.) are what make deep stacks trainable

gaps.statement: Recurrent models compute sequentially and convolutional models need several layers to connect distant positions, so no existing transduction model is both fully parallel and connects any two positions in a constant number of operations.

contributions.text: We propose the Transformer, an encoder-decoder based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions.
On WMT 2014 English-to-German the Transformer reaches 28.4 BLEU, more than 2 BLEU above the best previous results including ensembles.

evidence.quote: The Transformer achieves better BLEU scores than previous state-of-the-art models

contributions.text: We show that the Transformer generalizes to English constituency parsing with large and limited training data.

omitted_refs.ba2016: layer normalization is an implementation detail of the method section, not of the introduction
